newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 21.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Sri Lanka Moslem Congress politburo to meet on Wednesday to discuss problems with ruling People's Alliance.
Interpol informs Sri Lanka of LTTE arms ship sailing from East European country with weapons and ammunition.
Deputy Defence Minister Anuruddha Ratwatte says 80 percent of area controlled by LTTE has been liberated by security forces.
Indian Foreign Minister Inder Kumar Gujral to discuss plight of 160,000 "stateless" Tamils of Indian origin on plantations during forthcoming visit to Sri Lanka.
Deputy Defence Minister Anuruddha Ratwatte appeals to southern youth to join army to fight Tamil Tiger rebels.
Suspected Tamil rebels seize two jeeps and kidnap five people from Yala wildlife park, police say.
Security forces destroy LTTE Sea Tiger base in north.
